description: A single, modern armchair with a sleek metal frame and comfortable upholstery. The chair features a dark metal base and legs, with curved metal tubing forming the armrests and back support. The seat and back are padded with a textured blue fabric, providing a plush feel. A vibrant coral-colored throw pillow with a quilted pattern rests on the seat, adding a pop of color and extra comfort. The design suggests a blend of industrial and contemporary aesthetics, making it a stylish addition to various living spaces.
